svg.text: auth-al — team · the three operations
CREATE — the caller names the team, Auth-AL names the record
abv team create --name Finance
id fy6x64fvfnk0 <- issued, not chosen
name Finance
parent (root)
rc=0
# create covers subteams too — --parent makes it one. the handbook says
# "team create covers creating teams and subteams", so there is no second
# operation for it.
DELETE — refuses while ANYTHING depends on the team
abv team delete fibggi2juubk # Team1 has a child
operation conflict rc=4
abv team delete fibggi2juxhc # Team2 has a member
operation conflict rc=4
abv team delete fy6x64fvfnk0 # a leaf nobody is in
removed fy6x64fvfnk0 rc=0
# a child team, a membership, or an assignment naming it each block it.
# nothing cascades and nothing is soft-deleted: a delete that quietly
# removed memberships would make one administrative act perform another,
# and the handbook keeps those authorities distinct. the caller empties
# the team first, deliberately.
# that also leaves the envelope's state column unused — no record uses it,
# so nothing invents a lifecycle here.
REPARENT — refuses a cycle AT THE WRITE, not at resolution
abv team reparent fibggi2jur5s --parent fibggi2juxhc
operation rejected or record not found rc=3
abv team reparent fibggi2juxhc --roots
parent (root) rc=0
# validateTeamChain already catches a cycle at resolution. refusing it
# here as well is not redundant: accepting one would leave the store
# holding a state that can never resolve — the same defect a cascading
# delete produces, one step later.
# re-parenting is "team write", not a new authority: the handbook says
# team write INCLUDES membership management, so it is broader.
MEMBERSHIP — the pair is the identity
abv team add-member --id fibggi2juxhc --human fi7io4lvjqio
added team=fibggi2juxhc human=fi7io4lvjqio rc=0
abv team add-member --id fibggi2juxhc --human fi7io4lvjqio
operation conflict rc=4
abv team remove-member --id fibggi2juxhc --human fi7io4lvjqio
removed team=fibggi2juxhc human=fi7io4lvjqio rc=0
abv team remove-member --id fibggi2juxhc --human fi7io4lvjqio
operation rejected or record not found rc=3
# a repeat is a conflict, not a silent second row. removing someone who
# is not there is not-found, not a silent success. a caller always learns
# whether its write did anything.
THE LOST FOREIGN KEY, NOW A RULE
abv team add-member --id fy6x28qcdrxx --human fi7io4lvjqio
operation rejected or record not found rc=3
# memberships -> teams went with the fold. validation refuses the same
# thing the database used to, and a test asserts it.
